y-m-31-04.title: Tinogona kutaura chii nechokwadi kana tichiziva chete mean ne standard deviation?
y-m-31-04.topic: Zvinogona kuudzwa ne mean ne standard deviation oga
y-m-31-04.goal: Paradzanisa zvinogona kutaurwa nechokwadi, zvinogoneka asi zvisina chokwadi, nezvaunoda kuziva zvakawanda kana mean ne standard deviation chete zvapiwa, uye utsvage iwe pachako makosha asingagoneki.
y-m-31-04.material: Mean yetest yemath (0 kusvika ku100 mapoinzi, ma score ndema integer) yakatorwa nevadzidzi 30 vekirasi imwe ye grade 9 yechikoro ndi70 mapoinzi, uye standard deviation ndi5 mapoinzi. Ma score emunhu mumwe nemumwe haazivikanwi. Vadzidzi 30 ava vekirasi ndivo vanhu vose vakaongororwa, saka variance (= 25) ikukosha kwakawanikwa nekuparadzanisa ne30. Saka kana ukawedzera ma deviation ose akaitwa square evadzidzi 30, ndi25×30=750.
y-m-31-04.thinking.1: Kuratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti chimwe chinhu 'hachigari chechokwadi'
y-m-31-04.prereq.0: Zvinoreva mean, deviation, variance, ne standard deviation (grade 9). Sezvo variance iri mean yema deviation akaitwa square, hukama (huwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square) = (huwandu hwemakosha e data) × (variance)
y-m-31-04.prereq.1: Deviation yakaitwa square inogara iri 0 kana kupfuura
y-m-31-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvaunogona kutaura kuti zvinofanira kuva zvechokwadi kubva paruzivo rwekuti mean ndi70 mapoinzi uye standard deviation ndi5 mapoinzi chete.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kune chirevo chimwe nechimwe, gadzira iwe pachako rondedzero imwe kana mbiri dzema score dzinoita kuti chirevo chive chenhema, uye utarise kuti mean nehuwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square zvinosangana here.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti score imwe ndi40, uye funga kuti square ye deviation yemudzidzi iyoyo inofanira kukodzera sei nehuwandu hwema square eema deviation ose.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.o.a: Ma score evadzidzi vekirasi iyi ose ndi65 mapoinzi kana kupfuura uye 75 mapoinzi kana pasi.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.r.a: Standard deviation ye5 haireve 'mudzidzi wese ari mukati memapoinzi 5 e mean'. Kunyangwe vamwe vari kure zvakanyanya, standard deviation inogona kuramba iri 5.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.o.b: Pane mudzidzi mumwe kana kupfuura mukirasi iyi ane 70 mapoinzi chaizvo.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.r.b: Mean ye70 haireve kuti panofanira kuva nemudzidzi akawana 70. Mean inogona kuva 70 kunyangwe paine 60 mapoinzi ne80 mapoinzi chete.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.o.c: Pane mudzidzi mumwe kana kupfuura akawana score yakakura kupfuura 70 mapoinzi.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.r.c: Standard deviation haisi 0, saka ma score haagoni kuva 70 mapoinzi ose, uye mean ndi70, saka kana pane mudzidzi ari pasi pe70 panofanirawo kuva nomumwe ari pamusoro. Wakabatanidza zvinoreva mean nechokwadi chekuti standard deviation haisi 0.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.r.d: Mean ne median zvinogona kusiyana. Kubva pa mean ne standard deviation oga haugoni kuziva score iri panzvimbo yepakati.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.o.e: Hapana mudzidzi mumwe chete mukirasi iyi ane 40 mapoinzi kana pasi.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.r.e: Kana deviation ri30 kana kupfuura, deviation yakaitwa square yemudzidzi mumwe oga ndi900 kana kupfuura. Inopfuura huwandu hwose 750, saka hazvigoneki. Uku kufunga kwakanaka kwakashandisa chokwadi chekuti huwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square hwakatarwa.
y-m-31-04.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square hwakatarwa pa750, saka deviation yakaitwa square yemudzidzi mumwe haigoni kupfuura 750. Pa40 mapoinzi deviation ndi-30 uye square ndi900, saka hazvigoneki. Zvakare, kana standard deviation isiri 0, ma score haagoni kuva akafanana ose, uye sezvo mean iri 70, pane mudzidzi ari pamusoro pe70. Median, kuvapo kwemudzidzi ane 70 mapoinzi, ne 'vose vari pa65 kusvika ku75 mapoinzi' hazvigoni kutaurwa kubva paruzivo urwu oga.
y-m-31-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise ma score 3 akasiyana zvechokwadi asingagoni kuva score yemudzidzi mumwe mukirasi iyi. (Ma integer kubva ku0 kusvika ku100)
y-m-31-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza score imwe inogona kusarudzwa, verenga square ye deviation yayo, uye ufunge kuti kukosha uku kunogona kukodzera nehuwandu hwema square eema deviation ose here.
y-m-31-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kune ma score senge 45 mapoinzi ne60 mapoinzi, yedza kuti unogona kugadzira rondedzero yema score inogutsa mean 70 ne standard deviation 5 kunyangwe nemudzidzi akadaro here.

y-m-31-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Dai paiva nemudzidzi ane score iyi, huwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square 750 ne mean 70 hazvaigona kugutswa panguva imwe chete.
y-m-31-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Score iyi inogoneka mukirasi iyi. Pangava nemudzidzi ane score iyoyo, uye unogona kugadzira rondedzero yema score apo vadzidzi vamwe vachisangana nemean nehuwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square.
y-m-31-04.s.s2.explain: Deviation yakaitwa square yemudzidzi mumwe haigoni kupfuura 750, uye ma deviation evadzidzi vamwe 29 anofanira kuwedzera kuti abvise deviation yemudzidzi iyoyo, saka muchokwadi haigoni kupfuura anenge 725. Saka 43 mapoinzi kana pasi ne97 mapoinzi kana kupfuura hazvigoneki. 20 mapoinzi, 35 mapoinzi, ne100 mapoinzi mienzaniso inosefwa nyore, uye 43 mapoinzi ne97 mapoinzi mienzaniso yemuganhu inoda kuverengwa zvakanyanya. Kune rimwe divi, 45 mapoinzi inogoneka: kana mudzidzi mumwe ane 45, vashanu vane 75, uye makumi maviri nemana vane 70, mean ndi70 uye standard deviation ndi5.
y-m-31-04.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari yakati, 'Standard deviation ndi5 mapoinzi, saka mudzidzi wese mukirasi iyi ari pakati pe65 mapoinzi ne75 mapoinzi.' Nyora, nemuenzaniso chaiwo, kuti nei chirevo ichi hachigari chakarurama, uye unyorewo kuti chii chimwe chaunoda kuziva kuti utarise kuti chakarurama here.
y-m-31-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza rondedzero imwe yema score apo vamwe vadzidzi vari kunze kwe65 kusvika ku75 mapoinzi, uye utarise kuti mean nehuwandu hwema deviation akaitwa square hwerondedzero iyoyo zvinosangana here.

y-m-31-04.s.s3.model.0: Hazvigari zvakarurama. Semuenzaniso, kana mudzidzi mumwe ane 45 mapoinzi, vashanu vane 75 mapoinzi, uye vamwe 24 vane 70 mapoinzi, mean ndi70 uye standard deviation ndi5, asi pane mudzidzi ane 45 mapoinzi. Kutarisa, unofanira kuziva ma score emudzidzi mumwe nemumwe kana ma score ari pasi nepamusoro.
y-m-31-04.s.s3.model.1: Standard deviation inongova hukuru hunomiririra kuti ma score ari kure sei ne mean. Zvakanaka kuti vamwe vadzidzi vave kunze kwe65 kusvika ku75, saka haugoni kutaura kuti vose vari mukati. Unofanira kutarisa score distribution (tafura ye frequency) kuti uzive.
y-m-31-04.s.s3.model.2: Kunyangwe pane ma score ari kunze kwe65 kusvika ku75, mean inogona kuva 70 uye standard deviation 5. Semuenzaniso, mudzidzi mumwe ane 45, vadzidzi vashanu vane 75, uye vamwe vadzidzi 24 vane 70. Kutarisa, unofanira kuziva score yemunhu mumwe nemumwe.

y-m-31-08.s.s1.o.b: Mean yose iri pakati pe70 points ne80 points, asi unofanira kuziva nhamba yevadzidzi kuti uzive kukosha chaiko.

y-m-31-01.title: Kuwana kwakakanganisa mhinduro yaMinseo
y-m-31-01.topic: Kutarisa mhinduro nezve variance ne standard deviation
y-m-31-01.goal: Wana mutsetse wakakanganisa mumhinduro ye variance ne standard deviation, utaure chiratidzo chekuti mhedzisiro inoratidzika isiri iyo usina kuverenga zvakare kusvika pakupera, uye ugadzire iwe pachako seti imwe yedata ine mean ne variance zvakafanana.
y-m-31-01.material: Mamakisi equiz (mapoinzi) evadzidzi 5 vemuboka raMinseo i 4, 7, 5, 8, 11. Kuti awane kuti data iri rakapararira zvakadini, Minseo akagadzirisa seanotevera. Mutsetse mumwe wemhinduro yaMinseo wakatsauka. Vadzidzi 5 ava vese ndivo vanhu vari kuongororwa, saka variance inowanikwa nekupatsanura ne 5.
y-m-31-01.thinking.0: Kuwana kukanganisa nekutarisa chikonzero chemutsetse mumwe nemumwe wemhinduro
y-m-31-01.thinking.2: Kugadzira seti imwe yedata inogutsa mamiriro ese
y-m-31-01.prereq.1: Tsananguro dze variance ne standard deviation: mean yema squared deviations i variance, uye positive square root yayo i standard deviation (giredhi re9). Data mubasa iri i mamakisi evadzidzi vese, saka tinopatsanura nehuwandu hwemitengo yedata.
y-m-31-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakakanganisa mumhinduro yaMinseo.
y-m-31-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mutsetse nemutsetse, taura kuti nhamba iri mumutsetse mumwe neumwe yakabva sei panhamba iri mumutsetse unotangira pakarepo.
y-m-31-01.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga zvakare iwe pachako nhamba dzemutsetse mumwe nemumwe, uye utarise kuti nhamba iri mumutsetse wekupedzisira inoenderana sei nenhamba iri mumutsetse unotangira pakarepo.
y-m-31-01.s.s1.line.2: Huwandu hwema deviations = -3+0-2+1+4 = 0, saka mean yakawanikwa zvakarurama.
y-m-31-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse wakakanganisa i mutsetse 6. Kusvika pamutsetse 5, nhamba imwe neimwe yakabva zvakarurama pamutsetse wekare. Ma deviations ari negative mumutsetse 2 i mitengo yakajairika inoitika nekuti mamakisi ari pasi pe mean, uye ma deviations anowedzera kusvika ku 0 mumutsetse 3 anogara aitika kana mean yawanikwa zvakarurama. Mutsetse 6 wakatakura variance 6 sezvayakaita senge standard deviation. Standard deviation haisi variance asi positive square root ye variance, saka i √6 (anenge mapoinzi 2.4).
y-m-31-01.s.s2.prompt: Usati waverenga zvakare mutsetse 6, sarudza zviratidzo zvese zvinoita kuti mutsetse uyu uve unofanira kusahadzikwa.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa hukuru hwe standard deviation padivi pema deviations 5 -3, 0, -2, 1, 4 uye uenzanise.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mayuniti e variance ne standard deviation, uye utarise kana mayuniti maviri akafanana.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.o.a: Mitengo i negative sa -3 ne -2 yakasanganiswa pakati pema deviations.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.r.a: Deviation i negative kune makisi ari pasi pe mean. Sezvo dzichiitwa squares uye dzichiwedzerwa, kuva ne negatives hakuiti kuti mhinduro ive yakaipa.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.o.b: Standard deviation 6 i hombe kupfuura hukuru hwe deviation hombe zvikuru 4.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakatarisa kuti hukuru hwakajairika hwema deviations hahugone kuva hukuru kupfuura deviation hombe zvikuru. Kutarisa kwakanaka kwakaenzanisa hukuru hwemhedzisiro nedata.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.o.c: Pane mitengo yedata 5, uye kupatsanura ne 5 kana uchiwana variance kunoratidzika kwakaipa.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.r.c: Vese 5 ndivo vanhu vari kuongororwa, saka kupatsanura nehuwandu 5 i tsika yebasa iri. Mutsetse uyu hausi dambudziko.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.o.d: Variance ne standard deviation zvose i 6, asi mayuniti i points² ne points.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.r.d: Uku i kutarisa kwakanaka kwakaona zvichishamisa kuti huwandu huviri ane mayuniti akasiyana hunonyorwa nenhamba imwechete. Wakayeuka kuti yuniti inochinja kubva ku variance kuenda ku standard deviation.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.o.e: Zvinonzwika zvisina kujairika kuti kuwedzera ma deviations ese kwakapa 0.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.r.e: Huwandu hwema deviations hunogara hwuri 0 kana mean yawanikwa zvakarurama. Kuwana 0 i chiratidzo chekuti matanho ekare akarurama.
y-m-31-01.s.s2.explain: Unogona kuva nekusahadzika nenzira mbiri usina kudzokorora mhinduro kubva pakutanga. Chekutanga, standard deviation i mutengo wekumiririra hukuru hwema deviations, saka haigone kuva hombe kupfuura hukuru hwe deviation hombe zvikuru (pano 4), asi 6 yabuda. Chechipiri, variance (points²) ne standard deviation (points) zvine mayuniti akasiyana, asi nhamba imwechete yakanyorwa. Ma deviations i negative, kupatsanura ne 5, nema deviations anowedzera kusvika ku 0 zvese zvakajairika.
y-m-31-01.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira mamakisi 5 akasiyana nedata rekutanga (4, 5, 7, 8, 11) asi ane mean yemapoinzi 7 uye variance ye 6. Mamakisi i integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 15, uye makisi rimwechete rinogona kuoneka kakawanda. Gadzira seti 2 dzedata dzakasiyana. (Dzakasiyana nenhevedzano chete i data rimwechete.)
y-m-31-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti huwandu hwe 5 hunofanira kuva hwakadini, uye uise mamakisi kuti madhuri kubva pa mean (ma deviations) apararire pakati pe -3 ne 4.
y-m-31-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kana wasarudza mamakisi, ita squares ema deviations uye utarise kana huwandu hwawo i 30.
y-m-31-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Mamakisi i integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 15.
y-m-31-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Ita mamakisi integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 15.
y-m-31-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Mean haisi mapoinzi 7. Tarisa huwandu hwe 5.

y-m-31-03.title: Mean yakakwira asi pakati pakaramba pakafanana
y-m-31-03.topic: Kuchinja kwakasiyana kwe mean ne median
y-m-31-03.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako, zvichienderana nemamiriro, nyaya apo ma score mashoma chete anochinja zvekuti mean ichinja asi median ichiramba yakadaro, uye utsanangure kuti makosha maviri aya anotaura zvinhu zvakasiyana.
y-m-31-03.material: Ma score ekuongorora kuita (mapoinzi) evadzidzi 5 aiva 60, 65, 70, 75, 80. Mean ne median zvose zvaiva 70 mapoinzi. Zvirevo zvekupa mapoinzi zvakagadziriswa, uye ma score emudzidzi aiva ne60 mapoinzi nemudzidzi aiva ne80 mapoinzi chete ndiwo akaongororwa zvakare. Daidza ma score matsva a mapoinzi ne b mapoinzi (ma integer kubva ku0 kusvika ku100), uye ma score evadzidzi vamwe vatatu (65 mapoinzi, 70 mapoinzi, 75 mapoinzi) anoramba akadaro. Mushure mekuongororwa zvakare, mean yakakwira ne4 mapoinzi kana kupfuura kubva ku70 mapoinzi, asi median yakaramba iri 70 mapoinzi.
